title.value: BALAUR: Language Model Pretraining with Lexical Semantic Relations
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the focus of the paper on introducing BALAUR, a model for language model pretraining with lexical semantic relations.
title.quote: Title of the paper: BALAUR: Language Model Pretraining with Lexical Semantic Relations

extractions.description: The paper introduces BALAUR, a language model designed to improve the generalization and performance of pretrained language models by directly modeling lexical semantic relations (LSRs) such as hypernymy, synonymy, and antonymy in their latent representations during pretraining. This approach helps language models better understand reasoning and world knowledge, facilitating systematic generalization across various NLP tasks involving LSRs.
